title: autranella congolensis
intro: Autranella congolensis, commonly known as the African willow, is a plant species native to tropical Africa, particularly in the Democratic Republic of Congo, from where it gets its name. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from pain, fever, and inflammation due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Autranella congolensis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of Autranella congolensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
